from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentInfo(BaseModel):
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document")
    legal_cause: str | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action (案由) identified in the document")
    case_category: str | None = Field(description="The broad legal category of the case, e.g., Civil, Criminal, Administrative")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgments: list[JudgmentInfo]
